headline: Nikkei Asia reports that SoftBank's SB Energy is laying the groundwork for founder Masayoshi Son's AI push, including a planned gas-fired power complex and giant data center campus at a former uranium enrichment site in Piketon, Ohio.
score_reason: Only the opening of a feature was visible, so details are unverified; lowered 1 from 5.
importance_line: Piketon's roughly 2,000 residents and the local grid are most affected and SoftBank's investors take on heavier capital costs from a shift into infrastructure, but the cost and timetable are not stated here.
summary: Nikkei Asia reports that SB Energy is doing the groundwork for SoftBank Group chief Masayoshi Son's AI plans, including a planned gas-fired power complex to feed what would be one of the world's largest data center campuses at a former uranium enrichment site in Piketon, Ohio.
notes: Subscription wall: only the opening paragraph and caption were readable; no other outlet carries the feature.
